# Click all 14 green blocks one by one, monitoring bar growth
seg = current_frame.segmentation
n_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(n_nodes)}")

# Get center of each green block
green_centers = []
for n in n_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    green_centers.append((center_row, center_col))

# Click all green blocks
for i, (row, col) in enumerate(green_centers):
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col}])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    n_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    purple_bar = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p' and any(p[0] == 63 for p in n['boundary'])]
    bar_pixels = purple_bar[0]['pixels'] if purple_bar else 0
    
    print(f"After click {i+1}: green={len(n_nodes)}, bar={bar_pixels}, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("GAME OVER!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break

# After clicking all, try moving LEFT
if not last_action_result.get('game_over') and not last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
    print("\nMoving LEFT to complete...")
    for i in range(5):
        action(['LEFT'])

        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        purple_bar = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p' and any(p[0] == 63 for p in n['boundary'])]
        bar_pixels = purple_bar[0]['pixels'] if purple_bar else 0
        print(f"  bar={bar_pixels}")
        
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
            break

</function>
